## Executor.execute() method

Execute one operation and return its result in wire form: the value `request.outputPlan` describes, or a [PageWindowResult](./core.pagewindowresult.md) when `request.page` is present.

**Signature:**

```typescript
execute(request: ExecutionRequest): Promise<WireValue>;
```
